source: Unmodified device screenshots; page-layer crop and numerical annotations, original full image linked

maps.zh: 新建 SOP 任务：先选类型，再命名并创建
maps.en: Create an SOP task: choose a type, name it, then create

zh: SOP 工序：任务类型区右侧
物件/手部：类型下方两张选择卡片
任务名称：窗口下半部输入框
创建并编辑/取消：窗口右下角
en: SOP workflow: right side of task type
Object/hand choices: two cards below the type
Task name: field in the lower half
Create and Edit / Cancel: dialog footer

maps.zh: 编辑器总览：方案、导航、目标、参考与完成入口
maps.en: Editor overview: plan, navigation, targets, references, and completion

zh: 方案栏：摄像头、导出和导入；窗口控制在其上方右侧
步骤栏：顶部的排序与收起/展开，下面为步骤列表
主区左上：视频/目标模式切换
画布右上：缩放、适应窗口、平移
主图右侧：参考列表与补充角度
编辑器右下：完成；它先返回任务草稿
en: Plan bar: camera and import/export; window controls are above at right
Step list: reorder/collapse at top, step cards below
Workspace upper left: Video / Targets
Canvas upper right: zoom, fit, and pan
Right of picture: reference list and Add view
Editor footer right: Done returns to the task draft

maps.zh: 摄像头入口：认证、搜索、已有地址
maps.en: Camera controls: credentials, discovery, and an existing address

zh: 摄像头账号与密码：浮层中部，两者均未填写
搜索摄像头：密码框右侧
已有视频地址/未搜索到设备：表单下方折叠入口
收起：浮层右上，返回主编辑区
en: Camera credentials: middle of popover; both fields are empty
Find cameras: right of password
Existing address / camera not found: disclosure below fields
Collapse: popover upper right

maps.zh: 教学视频：素材工具、播放器和总选段
maps.en: Teaching video: media tools, player, and the overall range

zh: 主区上方右侧：上传、录制、画区域、添加目标
播放器左下：播放/暂停；右下为音量和全屏
播放器底部：视频播放进度条
播放器下方：总范围，供目标抽帧和方案验证
总范围下方右侧：补充验证录像、验证本方案
en: Workspace upper right: Upload, Record, Draw region, Add target
Player lower left: play/pause; volume and fullscreen are at right
Player bottom: playback seek bar
Below player: overall target-scan / plan-validation range
Below range at right: Add validation video and Validate plan

maps.zh: 重新录制：先阅读替换范围，再选择取消或开始
maps.en: Re-recording: read the replacement scope before cancelling or starting

zh: 窗口正文：替换对象、起止时间重置及保留内容
取消：保留当前编辑并返回
开始录制：明确需要替换素材时才执行
en: Dialog body: replacement scope, reset ranges, and retained data
Cancel: keep current editing and return
Start recording: use only when replacement is intended

maps.zh: 画布：查看工具和目标框
maps.en: Canvas: view controls and target box

zh: 画布顶部右侧：减号、比例、加号、适应窗口、移动画面
画面内目标框：单击选择、双击编辑、右键更多
画布顶部左侧：当前交互提示
en: Canvas top right: minus, scale, plus, fit, pan
Target box: select, double-click to edit, right-click for more
Canvas top left: interaction hint

maps.zh: 目标资料：参考列表、补充角度和完善识别
maps.en: Target references: view list, additional views, and recognition review

zh: 当前目标卡片：检查名称、参考数和待采用数
右侧标题：当前目标与图片/待采用数量
补充角度：参考图片标题右侧
角度卡片：选中后在主图核对该参考
帮我完善识别：目标标题条右端
en: Current target card: name, reference count, and pending count
Reference panel header: selected target and image/pending counts
Add view: right of the Reference image title
View card: select and compare with the main picture
Improve recognition: right end of the target heading

maps.zh: 时间轴：精确时间、预览、起点、终点与播放头
maps.en: Timeline: exact times, preview, endpoints, and playhead

zh: 起点/终点文字：此图正在编辑起点，单位与格式见正文
时间编辑后面的预览、保存、取消、定位
选起点/选终点：把有效预览位置设为相应端点
绿色起点手柄：决定片段开始
橙色终点手柄：决定片段结束
白色播放头：当前回看时间，不是范围边界
en: Start/end text: the start is being edited in this figure
Preview range, Save, Cancel, and Go to time after the fields
Set start / Set end: use the valid preview position
Green start handle: range beginning
Orange end handle: range end
White playhead: viewing position, not a range boundary

maps.zh: 手部动作配置：选择端点、动作、区域并添加
maps.en: Hand-action setup: choose endpoints, action, areas, and add

zh: 工具栏物件行：选择对应物件
工具栏手部行：选择任意一手、左手或右手
右侧动作选择：伴随移送或靠近后离开
动作图下方：起始区与到达区槽位
更下方：操作范围；应覆盖整个过程
面板右下：添加到本阶段，条件不完整时不可用
en: Toolbar object row: choose the relevant object
Toolbar hand row: choose either, left, or right hand
Action selector at right: move together or approach/withdraw
Below the action diagram: start and end region slots
Below the slots: operation area covering the process
Panel lower right: Add to this stage; disabled until valid

maps.zh: 检测设置：物件、手部、可选高级来源
maps.en: Detection settings: objects, hands, and optional advanced sources

zh: 上方卡片：物件能力与使用工序数
中部卡片：手部识别状态及用途
添加手部识别：未添加时显示
高级设置：按需要更换共用识别来源
返回工序：关闭设置返回编排；不是保存任务
en: Upper card: object capability and affected-step count
Middle card: hand-recognition state and purpose
Add hand recognition: shown when not yet added
Advanced settings: manage shared recognition sources when needed
Back to steps: return to editing; does not save the task

maps.zh: 检查关系：组合、物件、添加入口与具体要求
maps.en: Check configuration: combination, object, add slot, and details

zh: 左侧组合选择：全部同时满足等
左侧图示物件：点击选择要设置的条件
图示下方虚线入口：添加检查物件
右侧检查什么：本图下方还可继续滚动设置区域和更多参数
en: Combination selector at left: All at the same time, etc.
Diagram object at left: select the condition
Dashed slot under the diagram: add a check object
What to check at right: condition type
Where to check: region; Replace object below changes the target
More settings: score and other less frequent parameters

maps.zh: 完成方式：自动/辅助/人工、持续时长和高级时间
maps.en: Completion: automatic/assisted/manual, hold duration, and advanced timing

zh: 完成方式下拉框：决定由系统还是人确认
持续确认滑杆：调整满足要求的持续时长
秒数输入框：直接填写持续时间
高级设置：继续向下查看输入短暂中断与完成时限
en: Completion-method selector: system or operator confirmation
Confirmation hold slider: required stable duration
Seconds field: enter the duration directly
Advanced: brief input interruptions
Time limit near the bottom: step deadline; 0 disables timeout

maps.zh: 目标选择：搜索、卡片、分页、选择计数与提交
maps.en: Target picker: search, cards, pages, selection count, and submit

zh: 上方搜索框：按名称或来源筛选
中部卡片：勾选目标；灰色卡片可能已加入本步
列表右下：页数与上一页/下一页
窗口左下：已选数量和可新增数量
窗口右下：取消或添加所选项
en: Search at top: filter by name or source
Cards in the middle: select; a disabled card may already be in the step
List lower right: pages and previous/next
Dialog lower left: selected count and remaining allowance
Dialog lower right: Cancel / Add selected

maps.zh: 工序排序：调整模式、上下移动、无序分组与阶段操作
maps.en: Reordering: mode, movement, unordered groups, and stage controls

zh: 左栏顶部：完成调整，退出排序模式
每张步骤卡片下：上移/下移
第一步下方：与下一步组成一组，适合可任意先后的工作
阶段工具栏右上：删除本步、拖动柄及移动按钮
en: Step list top: Finish reordering exits ordering mode
Below each step card: move up/down
Below the first step: Group with next step for independent work
Stage toolbar upper right: delete, drag handle, movement controls
